contentHtml: In addition to his well-known public roles, he worked very hard to help and befriend me when I was younger.  Here are the Google searches for Victor.  Less well known about Victor is that he had one of the world’s best collections of private letters.  He also once gave me a very nice small painting by Jack Savitzky, for which I remain grateful.
